about:
.RIO is a generic top-level domain (gTLD) delegated in the DNS root zone. The registry operator responsible for .RIO is listed by IANA as Empresa Municipal de Informática SA - IPLANRIO. Anyone can typically register a .RIO name through an accredited registrar, subject to the registry’s registration policy and ICANN consensus policies.

The domain name rio is a top-level domain (TLD) for Rio de Janeiro in the Domain Name System of the Internet. On 27 February 2014, ICANN and Empresa Municipal de Informática SA – IPLANRIO entered into a Registry Agreement under which Empresa Municipal de Informática SA – IPLANRIO operates the rio TLD. It was officially launched in 2015.
